sources.sections: Institution identity; history; mission; vision; Big Sur campus; public workshop and private conference programming
sources.title: About Esalen: History, Mission, Vision, and Leadership
sources.note: Primary institutional identity source. Describes Esalen as a nonprofit holistic learning and retreat center founded in 1962, with programming oriented toward personal, spiritual and social transformation.

sources.sections: Overnight inclusions; accommodation categories; tuition; shared accommodation; ADA contact; meals; hot springs; pool; open classes; workshop inclusion; partner fees
sources.title: Accommodations & Tuition
sources.note: Core overnight-entitlement source. Overnight stays include accommodation, three meals per day, open classes and/or workshop access, 24-hour hot-spring use and other campus facilities. Accommodation type changes price, occupancy and privacy conditions. Some course fees may be paid separately to a partner organization.

sources.sections: Arrival; departure; Gate check-in; room keys; workshops; meals; communications; health services; road access; deposits; payments; changes; cancellations
sources.title: Planning Your Visit
sources.note: Primary lifecycle and policy source. Establishes arrival after 2 PM, room-key availability at 4 PM, room vacation by 10 AM, continued property access through 2 PM, meal windows, remote-service constraints, deposits, final payment and cancellation rules.

sources.sections: Visitor access; tours; transportation; camping; accessibility; guest policies; creator visits
sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions
sources.note: Clarifies access boundaries. Esalen does not offer casual tours or walkabouts, identifies property-access and accommodation constraints and acknowledges that parts of the cliffside property remain challenging for accessibility.

sources.sections: Lodge; meals; baths; pool; shared campus spaces; photography restrictions
sources.title: Campus Features
sources.note: Campus and spatial source. Documents communal dining, hot-spring and bath environments and relevant privacy rules, including prohibition of photography and video at the baths.

sources.sections: Healing Arts; workshop guest route; day-pass route; booking; pricing; arrival/departure extensions; access; cancellation; practitioner services
sources.title: Healing Arts at Esalen
sources.note: Documents a distinct ancillary-service relationship. Overnight guests and day-pass visitors use different access and pricing routes; sessions require separate reservations and payment, capacity can sell out, and an extension fee can expand property access beyond ordinary arrival/departure windows.

sources.sections: Self-Guided Exploration proposition; open classes; optional participation; campus features; Healing Arts; schedule
sources.title: Self Guided Explorations
sources.note: Primary optional-participation source. Self-Guided Exploration allows guests to shape their own experience through open classes, activities, solitude and optional Healing Arts rather than participation in one preregistered workshop.

sources.sections: Open-class eligibility; first-come first-served access; schedule variability; registered guests
sources.title: Open Classes
sources.note: Establishes a shared but capacity-sensitive participation layer. Open classes are available to registered guests on a first-come, first-served basis and schedules may change.

sources.sections: Current program availability; Self-Guided Exploration; registration routes; availability; program dates
sources.title: Self-Guided Explorations Week of October 19 - 23, 2026
sources.note: Time-bounded program example showing live program capacity and multiple registration pathways. Used only as a current example, not as evidence that availability remains unchanged after the access date.

sources.sections: Workshop reservations; Healing Arts contact; public night bathing; general inquiries; lost property
sources.title: Contact Us
sources.note: Responsibility-routing source. Workshop reservations, Healing Arts and general inquiries have distinct contact routes. Public night-bathing reservations are currently listed as closed.

sources.sections: Personal information; transactions; email; third parties; payment data; cookies; analytics
sources.title: Privacy Policy
sources.note: Digital relationship source describing personal-information collection for registration and transactions, transactional and marketing email use, payment processing and third-party service relationships. It does not establish every offline or institution-wide data practice.

sources.sections: Workshop; accommodations and tuition; partner registration; lodging; meals; campus access
sources.title: Being Whole: Ritual, Respect, and Regulation
sources.note: Program-specific example showing that some workshop relationships can require tuition registration/payment outside Esalen followed by a separate Esalen accommodation booking, while lodging continues to carry meals, open classes and campus-facility entitlement.
